text:
Alex Chen: Quick handoff — I'm out at 18:00 UTC. Leaving the preflight notes for the v2.5 deploy at 20:00 UTC. Please take over the watch. Ping if anything looks off.

Priya Patel: Got it, thanks. Can you drop the smoke checklist and any known risks?

Alex Chen: pasted preflight checklist below:```
- pause auto-scaler
- set canary to 5% (recommend 2% first 15m if risk spike)
- run smoke: ./scripts/smoke.sh --env prod
- monitor latency p95 and error-rate in Redwood Console (routes -> /inference)
- watch gpu-node-3 for CPU/KV cache spikes
- rollback if error rate > 1% sustained for 5m or p95 > 1200ms
```

Sam O'Connor: Heads up — index migration kicks off ~T+10m after canary. I saw a small CPU spike on gpu-node-3 during the dry run. Suggest keep canary at 2% for first 15m and have drain on standby.

Maya Singh: Oncall coverage: I'll be primary watcher 19:50–22:30 UTC. Josh, can you be backup for rollback/infra if things go sideways?

Josh Ramirez: Yep, I can take backup. I'll monitor deploy-bot alerts and jump on rollback if needed. @Priya I can run the post-deploy smoke once canary looks stable.

Priya Patel: Thanks. Note we disabled warm-up cache to avoid double billing, so expect a small latency bump under load (observed ~80ms in staging).

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: v2.5 -> canary start at 20:00 UTC. Initiating preflight checks.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Deploy freeze window 20:00–21:00 UTC. Only emergency fixes allowed. :warning:

Alex Chen: Leaving runbook + logs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-v2-5 and logs at /var/logs/deploys/v2.5. Also put an alert if error-rate exceeds 0.5% in first 10m to be conservative.

Priya Patel: Quick rule: if errors > 5% abort immediately; otherwise keep rolling to 30% after 30m if stable. We'll reassess at 30m.

Maya Singh: I'll post status updates at ~20:10 and ~20:40 with canary metrics. :white_check_mark:

Josh Ramirez: I'll add a temporary pager escalation to me for deploy failures and ensure rollback runbook is pinned.

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — leaving notes in the ticket too. Good luck. :v:
